resources.string: When on, Raiun requires a fresh password or biometric unlock every time and removes remembered phone keys; older biometric keys remain available for per-use unlocks. When off, remembered locations can reopen on this phone after Raiun restarts, while the phone is unlocked. Unsupported devices or phones without a secure screen lock require fresh authentication each time.

Forget this vault on this phone?
Raiun will remove this phone’s saved unlock choice and local key for %1$s. You will need to authenticate again before it can be remembered.
